# PUT /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/lock

Lock an issue to restrict commenting to users with write access

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-319`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `LockIssueOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `lock_reason` | string | False |  |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — User lacks write permission on issues/pulls
- **404** — Issue not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.LockIssue | controller | Parse form for reason; Get issue by index; Check write permission; Call issues_model.LockIssue if not already locked |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | issues_model.LockIssue | repository | Set is_locked=true; Update issue column; Create lock comment in transaction |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| User must have write permission on issues/pulls to lock | authorization | !ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWriteIssuesOrPulls(issue.IsPull) |
| Lock is idempotent - if already locked, return success without action | business_logic | !issue.IsLocked |
